name: Hypercubes Are Strictly Contained in Daisy Cubes
scope: Finite graphs, using irredundant set-family representations where relevant.
statement: Every finite hypercube is a daisy cube, and the inclusion is strict.
proof: The full family $2^{[n]}$ is a down-set. The path $P_3$ has the down-set representation $\{\varnothing,\{1\},\{2\}\}$ but is not a hypercube.
